top_signals.title: Phenomenal Time To Be Investor, Not Consumer: Amoroso
top_signals.summary:
Anastasia Amoroso, chief investment strategist with Partners Group, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss the bullish sentiment in the stock market, the potential for volatility in the near future, and rising global yields.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
